A. Socialization: Family is the first school of the child. Teaches language, customs, values, traditions, and norms.
B. Social Control: Encourages acceptable behaviour. Discourages deviant behaviour.

D. Transmission of Culture: Transfers traditions from one generation to another.
Keywords: Socialization; Culture; Values; Norms

Keywords: Love; Affection; Emotional stability
